# Matheus Libonatti

> Official portfolio of Matheus Libonatti, a Brazilian software engineer and full-stack developer serving Brazil, Latin America, and remote teams.

Matheus designs and builds digital products, web platforms, APIs, integrations, automation, artificial intelligence workflows, SaaS products, databases, and scalable software architecture.

## Selected work

- [Nogueira Cardiologia](https://matheuslibonatti.tech/en/projects/nogueira-cardiologia/): A healthcare SaaS platform connecting acquisition, patients, appointments, payments, exams, and a custom CRM.
- [Tripoli Investimentos](https://matheuslibonatti.tech/en/projects/tripoli/): Financial UX/UI, SEO, CRM, simulations, consultative service, and a multi-solution sales pipeline.
- [Etranslink](https://matheuslibonatti.tech/en/projects/etranslink/): An editorial and logistics intelligence platform connecting shippers, carriers, industry, agribusiness, and foreign trade.
